name: InterContinental Doha Beach
positioning: Beachfront resort hotel (officially InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa) on Doha's longest beach in West Bay, with The Bay Club's private beach and pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a beach and pool base within minutes of Lusail and downtown Doha
Families who want a children's pool and playground on site
Spa-goers who want an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam

facts.text: The hotel is located on Doha's longest beach and nestled in landscaped gardens.
The outdoor pool is a free-form pool at The Bay Club.
Rooms are designed to be modern, comfortable and fresh with an Arabic twist, and have sleek spa-like bathrooms.
Club InterContinental, for guests in Club rooms and suites, offers complimentary breakfast, light refreshments, afternoon tea and evening cocktails in a lounge overlooking the Doha skyline.
The hotel is minutes from Lusail, downtown Doha, the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall and Doha Golf Club, and Al Qassar Metro Station is a short walk away.
Katara Cultural Village is about 1 kilometer from the hotel.
The Bay Club has a children's pool and playground.
The concierge can book a three-hour guided city tour of Doha.
Mykonos is a Greek taverna whose terrace, framed by olive trees, overlooks the pool and beach, with bouzouki music.
La Vue is a lounge overlooking Doha's skyline, with cocktails, wines, cigars, whiskies and cognacs.
The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.

highlights.text: The Bay Club offers Doha's longest private beach, a pool, a 24-hour gym, padel, tennis and squash courts, fitness classes and watersports.
La Mar Beach is a beach lounge with views of the West Bay skyline and the Arabian Gulf, with cabanas, sunbeds and a temperature-controlled pool.
Spa InterContinental has treatment rooms and suites, a private indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam facilities, plus separate relaxation rooms.
Suites such as the Ocean Suite may include a sea view and a separate bath and walk-in shower.

considerations.text: Summer temperatures spike, and the hotel recommends spending time by its chilled pool then.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside the central Doha district.
